_comment: PlantScope v4.1 — up to 11 houseplant-relevant classes. Stage 1 detector is single-class (leaf); the disease decision is owned by Stage 2. Order matches sorted(ImageFolder.classes), i.e. alphabetical. Regenerated by train_notebook.ipynb. The actual class count depends on which classes survive the MIN_TRAIN_PER_CLASS=60 safeguard at the end of cell 10.

training.cutmix_safe: no mixing across not_a_plant <-> plant classes
